text:
Tara Lin: Quick design check for the latency header update — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/latency-header-v1 Please focus on p95 compacting, heatmap treatment for sparse samples, and sampling control microcopy.
Omar Weiss: Nice baseline. Two things: 1) p95 pill overlaps scrubber when window < 4m, 2) heatmap looks like holes at low sampling.
Pri Patel: For the p95 overlap, can we collapse to a small bars glyph under 420px and show a tooltip "p95: 210ms" on hover/tap? Glyph must expose aria-label.
Ben Cho: Agree on glyph. Accessibility note: avoid visually-hidden tricks — use aria-label like "95th percentile latency: 210 milliseconds" and keep the numeric tooltip for sighted users.
Tara Lin: Good. For heatmap, users confuse sparse sampling with zero traffic. Proposal: add a stippled overlay for buckets with sampleRate < 20% and a short legend: "Stippled = low sample density; results may be noisy."
Omar Weiss: +1. Also consider soft blur between adjacent buckets to reduce pixelation effect; keep intensity mapping but smooth edges.
Pri Patel: Microcopy update for sampling control: replace "Show samples" with "Sampling fidelity" and subtext "Dynamic (recommended) | High fidelity | Economy". Dynamic tooltip: "Adjusts sampling to balance accuracy and cost."
Ben Cho: Keyboard/focus bug: when opening time range popover, tab order goes presets -> calendar -> fidelity control -> Apply. Expected Apply before the fidelity control. Filing UX-7701: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-7701
UX Bot: Snapshot saved for 2170012345 — latency-header-v1. Lint: ensure collapsed glyph sets aria-label and that legend has id referenced by aria-describedby.
Tara Lin: Tiny CSS pattern for glyph mode (semantic-first):

```
.p95-glyph { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.p95-glyph[aria-label] { /* keep visible icon, semantics in aria-label */ }
```

Pri Patel: For stipple overlay: render a 1px diagonal dot pattern on buckets where sampleRate < 20% and add an off-screen label id for screen readers: "stipple-legend" that reads full explanation.
Omar Weiss: Rollout plan: behind feature flag — 1) copy change + glyph collapse, 2) heatmap stipple + smoothing, 3) focus-order fix. Docs update and changelog note included.
Tara Lin: Decision summary: desktop shows full "p95 210ms"; under 420px collapse to glyph with aria-label and tooltip; heatmap: blur edges + stippled overlay for low sample density with legend and aria-describedby; replace "Show samples" with "Sampling fidelity" (Dynamic/High/Economy) default Dynamic; fix popover focus order (UX-7701). I'll push updated frames tomorrow AM. Thanks! :sparkles:
